The '''Perception''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The SoroSuub Perception was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[July 22]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market.
